penz_home4_meryn.text: Take a coat. It is mizzle out there. That is mist and drizzle, all in one go.
The Jubilee Pool is a seawater lido from 1935, Art Deco style. It has been brave-swum since before my dad.
Say 'proper job' when something goes well. That means well done. Say it about my sandcastle and I will be very proud.

then.text: Mum says one flask is plenty. She will not say that twice.

else.text: Mum insists you take a flask of tea. I cannot stop her.
